subject: Request: Extra sandbox credits + 30-day POC extension for HelioMed
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.p@heliomed.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelioMed Procurement <procurement@heliomed.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: extra sandbox credits + 30d extension?

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team is really excited about Redwood's latency and embedding performance. We're close to a procurement decision but a couple of things slowed us down on our side: one internal security sign-off and our legal team's SOW timing. Because of that, we need a bit more runway to finish the integration tests.

Two quick asks:
- Can Redwood provide an additional 200k token sandbox credit on top of the initial trial?
- Would you be able to extend our sandbox access by 30 days (from the current end date of 2026-03-14 to 2026-04-13)?

We can commit to a signed SOW addendum and PO within that extension window. Procurement wants the extension and credits documented before they finalize the PO. I attached the current test scope for context.

Attachments: heliomed_poc_scope.pdf (PDF, 92 KB)

Appreciate any help you can provide — happy to hop on a call with the deal team if helpful.

Best,
Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
HelioMed
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: extra sandbox credits + 30d extension? (HelioMed)

Team — looping you in. HelioMed (RDW-2026-HELIOMED-003) just asked for a 200k token top-up and a 30-day extension due to internal procurement/legal delays. They say they'll sign an addendum and issue a PO within the extended window.

Why I think we should consider it:
- Tech validation is strong; their pilot showed the generative latency goal (<120ms) and embedding recall is good.
- They are mid-enterprise and likely to convert to Dedicated if procurement goes through.
- Small upfront cost relative to expected ARR if the deal closes.

Risks / controls I propose:
- Approve a one-time 200k token credit, expiring 30 days after grant (no rollover).
- Require signed SOW addendum + PO within the extension window; credits disabled if not signed by 2026-04-13.
- Finance to mark credits as conditional (deal id tagged) and legal to prepare a brief addendum.

Requesting exec sign-off (Aditya) or direction from Deal Desk (Jordan/Marissa). Priya, can you queue a 1-page addendum draft (I attached a stub) and the DocuSign link?

Attachments: draft_sow_addendum.docx (DOCX, 34 KB)

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: extra sandbox credits + 30d extension? (HelioMed)

Mina / team — I reviewed the ask and the deal bucket. Given: pilot signals are positive, procurement timeline is the blocker, and the requested amount is within our discretionary uplift, I approve the following, with conditions: 

Approval (one-time, conditional):
- Grant 200,000 token sandbox credit to HelioMed, tagged to deal RDW-2026-HELIOMED-003.
- Extend sandbox access by 30 days to 2026-04-13.

Conditions (must be met before credits become active):
1) Signed SOW addendum executed via DocuSign (Priya / Legal to prepare).
2) Procurement PO uploaded to HubSpot (Finance to confirm PO number).
3) Usage cap: credits may be consumed only by the integration/test project; any production usage triggers an immediate review and possible suspension.
4) Marketing / CS to receive a short post-pilot evaluation within 7 days after extension end.

Operational items: Jordan — please route to Finance to set a conditional credit allocation and ensure credits expire automatically on 2026-04-13. Marissa / Legal — please draft the minimal addendum (scope, expiration, credit terms) ASAP; Priya please prepare DocuSign link and share to Samir once signed. Mina — coordinate confirmation to the customer and log the agreement in HubSpot.

I trust the team on the controls here — let me know if anything material changes.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@heliomed.com>

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 17:23:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Quick ask: extra sandbox credits + 30d extension? — Approved (conditional)

Hi Samir — good news: we have conditional approval to support your extended evaluation. Summary of the agreement below (signed off by our Sales Ops):

What Redwood will provide
- One-time 200,000 token sandbox credit, active once conditions are met.
- Sandbox access extended to 2026-04-13.

Customer commitments / conditions
- Execute the attached SOW addendum via DocuSign (link below).
- Upload PO to HubSpot before 2026-04-13.
- Credits are limited to test/integration traffic only; any production usage will trigger suspension and review.

Next steps
1) Priya has created the DocuSign addendum: https://app.docusign.com/link/HELIOMED-POC-ADDENDUM
2) Please review and sign. Once signed, Finance will provision the conditional credits and confirm the PO number.
3) I'll schedule a brief sync to confirm scope and test plan if helpful.

Attachments provided: draft_sow_addendum.docx, heliomed_poc_scope.pdf

If you prefer a quick call with Aditya on any of the conditions, happy to coordinate.

Best regards,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
